subject: Health facilities: hospitals
bill.title: Health facilities: hospitals; emergency medical screening and stabilizing treatment; require hospitals to provide. Amends 1978 PA 368 (MCL 333.1101 - 333.25211) by adding secs. 17028, 17528, 21528, 21528a, 21528b, 21528c & 21528d.

posted_text:
🏥 Healthcare
MI HB 6443 — Hospitals Could Be Required to Treat Emergencies – Here’s What Changes

Michigan hospitals could soon be required to provide emergency medical care to anyone who shows up at their doors with a serious condition. This bill would mean hospitals must treat someone if they’re experiencing severe pain, a life-threatening medical issue, or complications like ectopic pregnancy or labor. ...
